items.title: University Scholarship Application (continuing students)
items.blurb: One application for many A&M awards for students already enrolled. Opens October 15. Deadline February 1. Complete when status turns green. Need-based pieces also need an aid application; merit pieces do not.

items.title: Aggie One Stop — how to apply
items.blurb: Official explanation of freshman vs continuing vs transfer scholarship paths. Start here if you are unsure which door is yours.

items.title: Continuing student scholarships
items.blurb: Academic Excellence and other currently enrolled awards. Most last one year. Deadline February 1 through the University Scholarship Application.

items.title: A&M scholarship policies
items.blurb: Late applications are not considered. You cannot revise after submit. Resumes are not accepted — put activities on the application.

items.title: School of Education & Human Development
items.blurb: College home for kinesiology-related majors. Look here for department-level awards. Confirm current listings on the official page; they change by year.

items.title: Department of Kinesiology & Sport Management
items.blurb: Official department page. Use it to find current undergraduate contacts and any posted departmental scholarships.

items.title: American College of Sports Medicine awards
items.blurb: Professional association in exercise science. Awards are usually merit or membership based, not parent-income based. Confirm the current cycle on ACSM’s site.

items.title: NSCA Foundation scholarships
items.blurb: National Strength and Conditioning Association student scholarships. Typically require membership or field interest. Check current eligibility on the Foundation page.

items.title: SHAPE America awards
items.blurb: Health and physical education professional association. Useful if coursework leans teaching or physical education.

items.title: College Board BigFuture scholarship search
items.blurb: Established directory. Creating a profile may allow approved nonprofits and colleges to contact you if you opt into Student Search. Use a dedicated email if you sign up.
items.warning: Profile / marketing possible if you opt in.

items.title: Scholarships360
items.blurb: Curated public listings. Still verify every award on the sponsor’s own site before you apply. Never pay a fee.
items.warning: Third-party directory — confirm the official sponsor URL.

items.title: JLV College Counseling lists
items.blurb: Public lists organized by month and deadline. No account required to browse. Still open the official sponsor page before applying.
items.warning: Third-party list — confirm the official sponsor URL.
